creator: Poly Haven
attributionText: Not required by license. Optional credit: "Modular Electric Cables, Poly Haven, CC0".
originalFormat: glTF (separate .gltf + .bin + jpg textures), 1k texture resolution (downshifted from default 2k to stay well under the 15MB hero-asset budget for a 49-mesh modular kit), downloaded via Poly Haven public Files API (https://api.polyhaven.com/files/modular_electric_cables), no auth required
repackaging: Converted to single embedded .glb by quantaora-app/public/models/sourced/physics-fields/pack-polyhaven-glb.mjs (project-authored script). Original mesh/material data unmodified; only the container format changed.
notes: A modular kit of 49 separate meshes: plugs, connector boxes, and cable segments/bends (straight, curved, terminated). Intended to be picked apart per-node in-app (e.g. useGLTF + node lookup) to build individual 'wire' props for the circuit builder rather than shown as one assembled unit. Not render-inspected in a 3D viewer in this pass -- only structurally validated.
